prompt: Create a reusable wide horizontal cloud illustration for the background of an elegant women's Bible reading app. A natural photographic cluster of soft luminous white cumulus clouds, with delicate pale sky-blue shadows and warm ivory highlights. Photorealistic cottony depth, sophisticated peaceful editorial feel. Wide landscape composition, cloud bank roughly along the bottom two-thirds, irregular organic cloud silhouette fully isolated on a true transparent background. Softly feathered semi-transparent edges, no hard rectangle or sticker outline. No sky background, no sun, no text, no sparkle, no people, no religious symbols, no watermark. Suitable as a subtle translucent background accent behind app copy; center has softly sparse cloud detail.
